task: Implement the staged Process Playbook lifecycle (propose/diff/approve/reject) with decision-doc digest integrity, lineage, and human-approved candidates; never auto-file findings or touch gates.
outcome: Running 'npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-playbook' prints 'smoke passed'. The smoke runs the full lifecycle: playbook_propose --finding creates a staged proposal with lineage + proposalDigest; playbook_diff renders it read-only; playbook_approve with a stale --expectedProposalDigest is rejected (fail-closed) while a matching digest writes a candidate playbook to playbooks.json carrying lineage (status=candidate, not active); playbook_reject discards the proposal; no finding is auto-created and no gate is touched. Build clean; existing experience-layer + decision-doc smokes still pass; verifier prints TOTAL N | PASS N | FAIL 0.
facts: core/digest.js (B-2ccc) exports digestCanonicalJson — the leaf for proposalDigest; do NOT import the helper from decision-doc-promotion handler
finding subsystem: store.readFindings + signatureTag (Phase 1b B-4f46) provide the lineage source (sourceStoryId/sourceFindingId/sourceSignature)
decision-doc-promotion is the digest fail-closed precedent: proposalDigest + expectedProposalDigest; signature_registry CLI (B-4f46) shows command-policy/config/registry/cli-engine registration

active status requires explicit human approval; approve only yields candidate
Every playbook carries lineage to a source finding/story
proposalDigest via core/digest.js; approve fail-closed on stale expectedProposalDigest
